acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Verify preserved base SHA, mission branch, isolated workspace and approved changed paths.
AC-02: A frozen raw byte-zero Windows subprocess fixture produces a genuine contention RED on the preserved candidate.
AC-03: Repaired old/new contention matrix passes natively, including ten repeated exclusive-lock runs.
AC-04: Blocking, shared-lock, release, handle-error and partial-acquisition cleanup tests pass.
AC-05: Production metadata readers preserve payload bytes, limits, readability and active heartbeat behavior.
AC-06: Unknown or corrupt locked state fails closed; stale heartbeat cannot permit an unowned headless brain.
AC-07: Execute filelock, lease and standing suites; required ownership behavior passes and remaining failures are classified.
AC-08: Native HTTP provider/tool E2E changes fixture 41 to 42 and produces passing Go tests.
AC-09: CLI success/failure JSON assertions pass; reopened SQLite contains durable run-correlated evidence.
AC-10: Windows command compilation, schema tests, affected regressions and static checks pass with isolation evidence.
AC-11: Every failure is classified against reproduced baseline as introduced, preexisting, environment or unresolved.
AC-12: Independent QA verifies the final durable local SHA and executable hash without unauthorized remote actions.
must_have: Minimal repair of existing Go implementation.
Mixed-version RED/GREEN evidence using an independent historical primitive.
Continuous exclusion, readable metadata and fail-closed resident execution.
Disjoint writer scopes, independent QA and durable local acceptance.
nice_to_have: Offline non-Windows cross-compilation when existing tools permit.
out_of_scope: Ancillary modernization and unrelated baseline repairs.
Remote provider calls, outbound messages, push, deployment or release.
CrewSync SERVER_DONE claims without authorized server readback.
assumptions: Historical Windows compatibility targets the byte-zero implementation preserved before the candidate.
The existing loopback HTTP provider is the authorized provider E2E boundary.
Architecture freezes metadata strategy before product implementation begins.
Downstream execution recovers existing native authority and records PLAN_ACCEPTED.
risks: A simple byte-zero revert can break separate-handle metadata reads and heartbeat writes.
Source inspection found headlessBrain can construct a brain without a lease when the holder is marked Stuck; the PRD explicitly covers this.
Unchanged baseline: filelock passed; lease rewrite sampling and standing Linux-unit path assertions failed.
Independent PRD reviewer launch failed because its configured model was unavailable; local review is recorded in review-rubric.md.
Graph tools, make and process-level egress verification were unavailable or unverified.

issues.name: win32-mixed-version-lock-compat
issues.title: Repair Windows mixed-version LockFileEx exclusion
issues.description: At candidate 45b41f2c existing filelock_windows.go locks 1<<40, whereas historical binaries lock byte 0. RED before GREEN: use real Windows LockFileEx byte-zero holder in a new test; new Lock must return busy on another handle. Repair with minimal compatible protocol that retains both old/new exclusion, handles partial acquisition rollback, unlock, shared/exclusive semantics, and payload read safety. Preserve existing code and never invent new lock service; do not change schema or provider. Architecture document includes dual-range candidate and Windows mapping caveats; implement only proven safe design.

No partial lock leak; payload/metadata semantics correctly handled
